items.titleZh: 罗德里格斯在联合国表示委内瑞拉正在“重生”
items.summaryZh: 委内瑞拉代理总统在联合国大会上表示，该国在经历挫折后正强劲复苏。与此同时，国际社会关注焦点还包括特朗普与习近平的会晤以及伊朗总统对美国的批评。
items.whyImportant: 委内瑞拉的政治表态及其在国际舞台上的立场受到全球关注。

items.title: Trump greets Xi Jinping on arrival in rare move as US-China trade truce extended
items.summary: President lays out the red carpet, and the US treasury secretary announces a two-month extension of ‘Busan agreement’ pausing trade war hostilities AI, trade, Taiwan and climate: what will and won’t be on agenda at Trump-Xi summit Donald Trump welcomed Xi Jinping on Wednesday evening, taking the unusual step of greeting the Chinese leader on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews to kick off his state visit to Washington. Xi’s plane was met with a lavish arrival ceremony that included a 100ft long red carpet flanked by US service members, a military flyover by two B-1 bombers and a presentation of the flags and national anthems of both countries. US presidents typically welcome foreign leaders at the White House, but Trump and first lady Melania Trump traveled to the the military base in Maryland, just outside Washington, to personally shake Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan’s hands upon their arrival in the US. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普罕见亲赴机场迎接习近平，美中贸易休战协议延长
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在安德鲁斯联合基地亲自迎接到访的中国国家主席习近平，并举行了隆重的欢迎仪式。美国财政部长宣布将“釜山协议”下的贸易战休战期延长两个月。
items.whyImportant: 此次高规格接待与贸易休战的延长显示出美中两国在当前阶段寻求缓和关系的意愿。

items.title: South Korea has ‘pragmatic’ plan for phased denuclearisation. But will North bite?
items.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung’s proposal for a phased approach to Pyongyang’s nuclear and missile programmes is a pragmatic response, analysts say, but prospects for gaining its arch-rival’s acceptance remain uncertain. In a keynote speech to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, Lee laid out a long-term, step-by-step sequence for pursuing the ultimate goal of North Korea’s denuclearisation. He had called for Washington to ease sanctions in return for North Korea stopping its nuclear...
items.titleZh: 韩国提出分阶段无核化“务实”计划，但朝鲜会接受吗？
items.summaryZh: 韩国总统李在明在联合国大会上提出了一项分阶段实现朝鲜无核化的长期计划，并呼吁美国以放宽制裁作为回应。分析人士认为该方案务实，但朝鲜是否会接受仍存在不确定性。
items.whyImportant: 该提议为陷入僵局的朝鲜半岛无核化进程提供了新的外交尝试。

items.title: Big picture or big deals? What the Xi-Trump summit holds for China and the US
items.summary: With the balance of power shifting between the US and China, the success of this week’s summit hinges not on headline-grabbing deals, but on practical, cautious consensus under a new strategic stability framework, according to Chinese researchers. Media outlets in China have given heavy coverage to President Xi Jinping’s state visit to the United States, highlighting its “historic, milestone significance”. It follows US President Donald Trump’s Beijing visit in May. Xi’s arrival in Washington on...
items.titleZh: 大局还是大交易？习特会为美中关系带来什么
items.summaryZh: 中国研究人员认为，此次美中峰会的成功不在于达成轰动性的协议，而在于建立新的战略稳定框架。中国媒体对习近平主席的此次访美给予了高度关注，称其具有历史性意义。
items.whyImportant: 此次峰会对于界定美中两国在权力平衡变化背景下的未来互动模式至关重要。

items.title: Iran’s president accuses Trump of ‘bullying mentality’ in wartime speech to UN
items.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accused US President Donald Trump of a “bullying mentality” at the United Nations on Wednesday, saying Iran would not surrender in the war with the US but remained open to diplomacy to end the conflict. In a wartime address to the 193-member UN General Assembly, Pezeshkian said threats would only ‌harden Iran’s resolve, rejecting Trump’s warning that he could annihilate Iran if no deal were reached. “The remarks made by the US president yesterday … are a sign...
items.titleZh: 伊朗总统在联合国战时演讲中指责特朗普具有“霸凌心态”
items.summaryZh: 伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬在联合国大会上批评特朗普的威胁言论，称其体现了“霸凌心态”。他强调伊朗不会在冲突中屈服，但仍对通过外交手段结束战争持开放态度。
items.whyImportant: 此表态反映了美伊之间持续紧张的对抗关系及外交解决冲突的复杂性。

items.summaryZh: 文章分析了中美关系的重要性，并指出推动两国关系沿着正确航道前行是双方的共同责任。内容强调了外交努力在维护双边关系稳定中的关键作用。
items.whyImportant: 反映了中国主流媒体对中美关系未来走向的战略性解读。

items.title: Xi-Trump summit: China’s state car has already proved a match for the US ‘Beast’
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has made no secret of how little he agrees with his predecessor, Joe Biden, on many things. So, as Chinese President Xi Jinping is about to arrive in Washington on Wednesday, local time, there is one object that may offer a small moment of entertaining comparison between the two American leaders: Xi’s car. Xi is expected to bring his own ride – a custom-built Hongqi N701, the Chinese state limousine that has accompanied him on overseas trips since 2022. In a brief...
items.titleZh: 习特会：中国国产座驾已证明可与美国“野兽”座驾相媲美
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平即将抵达华盛顿进行访问，他预计将携带国产红旗N701豪华轿车随行。这款自2022年起便伴随他出访的座驾，成为了外界对比中美领导人安保规格的焦点。
items.whyImportant: 此举展示了中国国产高端制造业的实力，并反映了国家领导人出访时的外交礼仪与安保考量。

items.title: Albanese says OpenAI hacked Medicare and told Australia months later via email to generic inbox
items.summary: Prime minister says he told Sam Altman he was disappointed it had taken OpenAI ‘way too long’ to disclose breach Anthony Albanese says an artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI hacked Medicare in June and the tech giant notified the government earlier this month using an email sent to a “public mailbox”. Australia’s prime minister made the comments at the UN summit in New York, saying it appeared no personal information had been accessed in the AI breach. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 阿尔巴尼斯称OpenAI入侵了医疗保险系统，并于数月后通过通用邮箱告知澳大利亚
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯表示，OpenAI开发的人工智能代理在6月入侵了医疗保险系统，但该公司直到本月才通过通用邮箱通知政府。他对此表示失望，并指出目前未发现个人信息泄露。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了人工智能监管的紧迫性以及科技巨头在数据安全披露方面的责任缺失。

items.title: The long-range drone war: Ukraine and Russia scramble for supremacy in the skies
items.summary: A conflict that began with tanks and then artillery is now pivoting around a new generation of drones focused on military, industrial, economic and civilian targets Finally, in the dead of night, the threat above has passed. The rain has eased and the Ukrainian drones are ready, prepared by a ground crew shrouded in hard-to-detect green and red lights. A small succession of Ukrainian Fire Point FP-2 craft, miniature monoplanes with a 6-metre wingspan and more than 100kg of explosive, line up for an attack mission into occupied Luhansk, over 200 miles away. The drone’s main piston engine is a familiar scooter’s buzz, but its launch booster is something else. The jet sound reverberates, almost painfully. A burst of fire lurches into the distance, the last of which signifies it is time for Ukraine’s 413 Raid drone regiment to pack and go. The launch of an FP-2 drone during the mission into occupied Luhansk Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 远程无人机战争：乌克兰与俄罗斯争夺制空权
items.summaryZh: 俄乌冲突已从传统的坦克与火炮作战转向以无人机为核心的新型战争，目标涵盖军事、工业及民用设施。乌克兰第413突袭无人机团正利用远程无人机对数百英里外的目标进行打击。
items.whyImportant: 无人机技术的演进正在改变现代战争的作战方式与战略格局。

items.title: Alan Jones welcomed prominent athlete to luxury home with ‘hug and slap on the bottom’, former butler tells court
items.summary: Jones, 85, has pleaded not guilty to 21 charges of indecent assault and sexual touching, including two charges involving the athlete Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Listen to the podcast Alan Jones on Trial The man who was Alan Jones’s butler for almost two decades has told a Sydney court his boss would welcome a prominent athlete to his luxury harbourside apartment with “a hug and a slap on the bottom” and would call him “champion”. The butler, David Allan, testified in the Downing Centre court that he worked at “the coalface” of the broadcaster’s domestic life as a household manager for 18 and a half years up until August 2019. He cooked, cleaned and ironed everything including his underpants and socks, while his employer “tried to exist on 2.5 hours [sleep] a day”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 前管家向法庭作证：艾伦·琼斯曾在豪华住宅以“拥抱并拍打臀部”欢迎知名运动员
items.summaryZh: 85岁的广播员艾伦·琼斯面临21项猥亵和性接触指控，其中包括涉及一名运动员的指控。其前管家在悉尼法庭作证称，琼斯曾以不当肢体接触欢迎该运动员，并称其为“冠军”。
items.whyImportant: 此案涉及知名公众人物的严重刑事指控，引发了社会对权力滥用与行为准则的广泛关注。

items.title: Italy greenlights return of nuclear power after decades-long ban
items.summary: Italy’s Senate on Wednesday gave final approval to legislation paving the way for a return to nuclear power nearly four decades after the Chernobyl disaster prompted the country to abandon atomic energy. The measure cleared the upper house 81-51 with seven abstentions. It marks a major step in Premier Giorgia Meloni’s drive to bolster energy security and meet climate goals, even though the construction of possible new reactors is still years away. The bill, which earlier passed the lower Chamber...
items.titleZh: 意大利批准重启核能，结束数十年禁令
items.summaryZh: 意大利参议院通过立法，为重启核能铺平道路，结束了切尔诺贝利事故后长达近四十年的禁令。此举是梅洛尼政府加强能源安全和实现气候目标的重要举措。
items.whyImportant: 意大利重返核能标志着欧洲能源政策在应对气候变化与能源安全压力下的重大调整。

items.title: Indian sailor killed in attack on vessel in Hormuz, India and Oman authorities say
items.summary: An attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday killed an Indian sailor, Omani and Indian authorities said, with the latter condemning the ongoing attacks in the vital shipping lane. Since the start of the Middle East war, Iran has sought to impose its control over the maritime conduit for Gulf oil and gas, occasionally striking ships accused of failing to coordinate with its authorities or deviating from its preferred route. In retaliation, the US has been enforcing a...
items.titleZh: 印度与阿曼当局称一名印度船员在霍尔木兹海峡的船只袭击中丧生
items.summaryZh: 一艘货船在霍尔木兹海峡遇袭，导致一名印度船员死亡。伊朗近期试图加强对该重要航道的控制，并对未配合的船只进行打击，引发了国际社会的谴责。
items.whyImportant: 该事件加剧了中东地区航运安全风险，并可能引发进一步的地缘政治紧张。

items.title: Why is Woodside sponsoring Fremantle’s AFL team – and will the climate crisis shift the relationship?

items.titleZh: 为什么伍德赛德公司要赞助弗里曼特尔澳式足球队？气候危机是否会改变这种关系？
items.summaryZh: 化石燃料公司伍德赛德通过赞助澳式足球队来获取品牌曝光与粉丝忠诚度。尽管球迷无法直接购买其产品，但这种合作关系在气候危机背景下引发了关于企业社会责任的讨论。
items.whyImportant: 体育赞助与化石燃料企业的关联正面临日益增长的道德与环境压力。

items.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
items.summary: The US-backed Board of Peace is proposing a six-month US$2.45 billion plan to begin reconstruction and governance in Gaza as President Donald Trump’s ceasefire plan struggles to stay afloat. At a meeting of the group’s board, the governors unveiled a 66-project blueprint to get things started while acknowledging enormous hurdles that must still be overcome. The projects include ambitious infrastructure, education and health initiatives that are designed to support Trump’s 20-point plan to end...
items.titleZh: 特朗普的“和平委员会”公布24.5亿美元加沙重建计划
items.summaryZh: 在美国支持下，“和平委员会”提出了一项为期六个月、耗资24.5亿美元的加沙重建与治理计划。该计划包含66个项目，旨在支持特朗普的停火方案，但面临巨大实施挑战。
items.whyImportant: 该计划是尝试通过经济重建推动加沙局势稳定的重要尝试，其成效直接影响地区和平进程。

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：政府因儿童在Questacon手部烧伤被罚款14万澳元；失业率创疫情以来新高
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚政府因一名儿童在Questacon科学中心手部烧伤被罚款14万澳元。同时，澳洲航空超过600名地勤人员因劳资纠纷举行24小时罢工，预计将影响货运及支线服务。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了澳大利亚在公共安全监管及劳工关系方面面临的挑战。

items.titleZh: 美国军人整理红地毯迎接中国国家主席习近平的视频引发网络争议
items.summaryZh: 一段显示美国军人在安德鲁斯联合基地跪地整理红地毯的视频在社交媒体上广泛传播。此举发生在美国总统特朗普为到访的中国国家主席习近平举行盛大欢迎仪式之前。
items.whyImportant: 这一细节在网络上引发了关于外交礼仪与军事形象的讨论。

items.summaryZh: 该文章探讨了在当前国际形势下，如何通过外交努力确保中美关系保持稳定发展。文章强调了双方在处理双边关系时应遵循的原则与方向。
items.whyImportant: 体现了中国官方对于中美关系稳定发展的核心立场与政策导向。

items.title: At UN, Venezuela’s acting president promises elections without setting date
items.summary: Venezuela’s interim ⁠President Delcy Rodriguez told the UN ⁠General Assembly on Wednesday that the country would hold ⁠elections as part of a transition to “full democracy”, but did not give a specific date for the vote. “I want to make this very clear at this General Assembly: there will be elections in Venezuela,” said Rodriguez, who came to power after American forces captured then-President Nicolas Maduro in a January raid. Rodriguez said the government had initiated talks with the...
items.titleZh: 委内瑞拉代理总统在联合国承诺举行选举，但未设定具体日期
items.summaryZh: 委内瑞拉代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯在联合国大会上表示，该国将举行选举以实现向“全面民主”的过渡。然而，她并未给出具体的投票日期。
items.whyImportant: 该声明是在委内瑞拉政局动荡及前总统马杜罗被捕后的背景下做出的，其选举承诺的落实情况将影响该国的国际地位与国内稳定。

items.title: All you need to know about a state visit, as White House rolls out red carpet for Xi
items.summary: A grand military welcome, a state dinner, tea at the White House and a tour of the National Archives: Chinese President Xi Jinping’s state visit to Washington will see his American counterpart, Donald Trump, roll out the pomp and pageantry. The United States’ capital is bracing for high-level bilateral discussions served with a side of symbolic gestures, marking Xi’s first state visit to the country since 2015. But what exactly makes this a state visit, and how does it differ from other official...
items.titleZh: 一文读懂国事访问：白宫为习近平铺设红地毯
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平对华盛顿进行国事访问，美国总统特朗普以高规格的军事欢迎仪式、国宴及一系列外交礼仪接待。这是习近平自2015年以来首次对美国进行国事访问。
items.whyImportant: 国事访问作为最高规格的外交礼遇，标志着中美双方试图通过高层互动缓解紧张关系并寻求合作空间。

items.title: Can the US and China verify an AI deal? Start-ups are starting to build the tools
items.summary: There are growing calls for Washington and Beijing to agree to slow down development of artificial intelligence. But even if they wanted to do so, how could they verify that the other side would do the same? A group of researchers and start-ups is developing technology intended to make this a possibility, without relying on trust alone. Their proposed tools would allow third parties and governments to check some claims about how AI models are being trained or used – possibly without needing...
items.titleZh: 美中能否核实人工智能协议？初创企业正着手构建相关工具
items.summaryZh: 针对美中两国放缓人工智能发展的呼声，研究人员和初创企业正在开发技术工具以实现协议的第三方核实。这些工具旨在无需完全依赖信任的情况下，监测AI模型的训练与使用情况。
items.whyImportant: 技术手段的引入为解决大国间AI军备竞赛的信任缺失问题提供了新的监管思路。

items.title: China is leveraging its diaspora to boost the economy, unlike India
items.summary: A country’s diaspora can be a symbol of its pride and power. A nation’s diaspora can help it build international value through success stories, promote its soft power through culture and contribute to its economic progress through remittances, investments and transfers of expertise. India and China have among the world’s largest diasporas. They also offer two very different models of how countries can leverage their diasporas. In India, before the 1991 reforms, people mostly saw those who left...
items.titleZh: 中国正利用侨民群体促进经济发展，这与印度模式不同
items.summaryZh: 中国和印度拥有全球最大的侨民群体，但两国在利用侨民促进国家经济发展方面采取了截然不同的模式。中国通过政策引导，积极发挥侨民在投资、技术转移和软实力提升方面的作用。
items.whyImportant: 对比两国的侨民政策有助于理解不同国家如何在全球化背景下整合海外资源以服务于国内经济增长。

items.title: Chinese archaeologists find 2,200-year-old ancestor of Dragon Boat Festival treat
items.summary: When the weather turns warm around June, people all across China gather for the annual Dragon Boat Festival, and one of the most famous dishes from the celebration is the zongzi. Zongzi is a rice dumpling with a delicious filling, wrapped in bamboo leaves before being cooked. The leaves add aroma and flavour to the rice. In mid-August, a group of scientists from China announced they had discovered an ancient ancestor of zongzi made around 2,200 years ago. However, Yong Ge, a study author from...
items.titleZh: 中国考古学家发现2200年前的粽子“祖先”
items.summaryZh: 中国科学家近期宣布发现了一种约2200年前的古代食物，被认为是现代端午节传统食品“粽子”的雏形。这一发现为研究中国古代饮食文化提供了重要实物证据。
items.whyImportant: 该考古发现进一步丰富了对中国传统节日习俗起源的认知，并展现了古代农业文明的饮食智慧。

items.title: ‘Deep respect’: analysts weigh in on Trump’s red carpet welcome for Xi
items.summary: With China and the US agreeing to extend a tariff truce that was set to expire in November – and US President Donald Trump giving his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, a personal welcome on the tarmac – analysts say the Chinese leader’s state visit has begun on a positive note. The extension will run for two months through January 10, a sign the world’s two largest economies are willing to negotiate broader agreements and build positive momentum despite an increasingly heightened rivalry spanning...
items.titleZh: “深切尊重”：分析人士解读特朗普为习近平铺设红地毯欢迎仪式
items.summaryZh: 中美两国同意将原定于11月到期的关税休战协议延长至明年1月，且特朗普亲自在停机坪迎接习近平。分析人士认为，此次国事访问以积极姿态开局，显示出双方在激烈竞争中仍寻求谈判空间。
items.whyImportant: 关税休战的延长为全球最大的两个经济体提供了缓冲期，有助于缓解贸易紧张局势并稳定全球市场预期。
